articles.title: Tehran launches more strikes after explosions reported in southern Iran
articles.description: Centcom says it hit 90 Iranian targets in the latest round of strikes, with the Iranian health ministry saying 14 people were killed since Tuesday.

articles.title: Big fall in oil, gas and cargo ships taking US-backed Hormuz route after new strikes
articles.description: Data shows a decline in the number of ships - many carrying oil and gas - going through the waterway after attacks this week.

articles.title: Ukraine strikes Russian ships near Crimea, escalating attacks on fuel supplies
articles.description: The attacks appear to be the latest phase of Ukraine's bid to choke off supplies and routes into and out of occupied Crimea.

articles.title: Starmer gifted gun and ammunition by Turkish president at Nato
articles.description: The weapon has not been brought back to the UK and has instead been left with British officials in Turkey.

articles.title: Nato allies announce £37bn for new missile project
articles.description: Prime Minister Sir Keir Starmer will convene around a dozen leaders to discuss the programme in Ankara.

articles.title: International court tells BBC of breakthrough in Sudan war crimes probe
articles.description: The ICC has been looking into atrocities committed in Darfur over the past three years.

articles.title: Teenager arrested after two girls, 13, seriously injured in German school attack
articles.description: Police said a major operation was under way in the area of Welfen-Gymnasium secondary school in Schongau, Bavaria.

articles.title: Ukraine to get licence to produce Patriot missiles, Trump says
articles.description: Although the Patriots are highly effective against Russia's ballistic missiles, they also have lengthy production times.
